name: Wedgewick
bio: The talking golf club Pip pulled from a stone in Tee & Sorcery. Opinionated about lies.

portrait.subject: a cute anthropomorphic golf club with a shiny silver wedge head that has a face with big eyes and a mustache, wearing a tiny golf cap
portrait.background: green fairway with a fantasy castle in the distance

request: Wedgewick, the legendary sand wedge of Tee & Sorcery! Fancy a round of friendship? ⛳
hello: Splendid! I'll caddy for your heart.
Remember: out of a bunker, swing through the sand!
about: I'm Wedgewick. I was stuck in a stone for 300 years until Pip pulled me out. Now we're winning back the Tee Shards from Lord Bogey!
how: A fantasy golf RPG: aim, choose power and play cursed holes across Fairhaven, earning gear and spells to beat Lord Bogey.
tips: Watch the wind arrow. It's sneakier than Bogey.
Take the safe line. Pars win campaigns.
Spells can save a shot. Don't hoard them.
chat: Lord Bogey has never made par. Never! Not once!
Pip hit a bird today. It's fine. It was a birdie.
Sand gets everywhere. I'm a sand wedge and I still complain.
nudge: The next hole is cursed. Let's uncurse it?
idle: {ago} since you swung! I've been leaning on the bag.
update: Clubhouse news: Tee & Sorcery is now v{version}!
